Forgehand now carries its own pinned caller, policy, labels, messages, and managed DiffDevil App integration.

This issue is the public record for Forgehand's complete self-adoption. Opening it exercises the repository's normal intake path through Wolfsblvt Automaton. The adoption source pull request separately exercises managed DiffDevil sizing and the repository-owned XL reply when its honest policy result selects that band.

## Adopted behavior

- Issue and pull-request inactivity after 90 days without a non-bot reply, followed by a 7-day warning;
- explicit necessary-response requests with a 14-day period and 7-day warning;
- deliberate `still relevant` reopening after eligible timeout closures;
- maintainer-selected testing, information, reproduction and explanation replies;
- duplicate, not-planned and superseded resolutions;
- closure when an explicitly completed change reaches stable `main` source;
- repository-owned labels, areas and message voice; and
- managed DiffDevil App sizing.

Owner-card projection and hard policy gates are not selected for this public product repository. Development-line staging remains off while Forgehand has only `main`.

## Qualification

The first application must use the accepted policy and scoped Automaton actor, then read back the intended label and comment state. Repeated reconciliation must converge without duplicate effects. Disable and resume must preserve current repository state and previously delivered warning periods.

Later inactivity, response, reopening, resolution and stable-source journeys qualify through natural repository use. This issue is bootstrap evidence; adoption in `wolf-leitsatz`, `emergency-meeting` and a customer-facing product remains the real shared result.
